root_cause: All three require surjectivity of rename_formula f, which requires surjectivity of f : String → String. Not provable for arbitrary f.

sorry_entries.statement: For all q in target kernel, if target admits q, then exists p in source kernel such that rename_proof f p = q and source admits p.
sorry_entries.custody_path: no — custody uses forward (source → target) direction only
sorry_entries.resolvable: conditional — if f is restricted to bijections on the variable set, yes. If left as arbitrary String → String, no.

resolution_options.approach: Constrain normalization_bridge to only accept bijective rename functions. Add a Bijective type class or hypothesis, then the reflection proofs follow from surjectivity.
resolution_options.effort: moderate — requires API change to normalization_bridge

resolution_options.approach: Document as an explicit trusted assumption with justification: reflection is not needed for custody (preservation direction suffices). Move to docs/trusted-assumptions.md.
Leave sorry with comment. Acceptable because NormalizationBridge is an example, not the core custody path.

sorry_entries.recommendation: quarantine_as_trusted_assumption — reflection is not on the custody path and NormalizationBridge is an illustrative example, not core infrastructure.

sorry_entries.statement: For all q in target kernel, if target admits q, then exists p in source kernel such that rename_proof f p = q and source admits p.
sorry_entries.requires: same as proof_reflection — surjectivity of rename_proof f

sorry_entries.statement: For all q in target formula kernel, if target admits q, then exists p in source formula kernel such that rename_formula f p = q and source admits p. Since both kernels are trivial (admits_proof = True), this reduces to: ∀ q, ∃ p, rename_formula f p = q — surjectivity of rename_formula f.
sorry_entries.requires: surjectivity of rename_formula f (equivalently, surjectivity of f : String → String)
sorry_entries.resolvable: conditional — NOT eliminable by proof restructuring alone. The trivial kernel makes preserves trivial but does NOT help reflects, because reflects still needs an existential preimage witness. Verified by analysis: the proof obligation reduces to ∀ q, ∃ p, rename_formula f p = q, which is surjectivity and is false for non-surjective f.

resolution_options.approach: Same as proof_reflection — constrain f to bijections.
Document alongside the other two. The trivial kernel does not make this sorry eliminable — it only simplifies the admissibility condition, not the preimage existence.

sorry_entries.recommendation: quarantine_as_trusted_assumption — earlier analysis suggesting this could be eliminated by restructuring was incorrect. The trivial kernel simplifies admissibility but not preimage existence.

unified_recommendation: All three sorry share the same root cause (surjectivity) and should be quarantined together as trusted assumptions. The reflection direction is not on the custody path — preservation (forward direction) is fully proven and suffices for custody. If future work restricts normalization_bridge to bijective renamings, all three can be simultaneously eliminated.
